```{r setup, echo=FALSE}
# Phoenix is headless, so use cairo for png rendering
options(bitmapType = "cairo")

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  fig.width = 10,
  fig.height = 7,
  fig.align = "center"
)

# Load Bioconductor packages before tidyverse
library(tximport)
library(rtracklayer)
library(DESeq2)
library(tidyverse)
library(reactable)
library(plotly)

theme_set(
  theme_bw(base_size = 12)
)
qc <- read_tsv(
  "../output/qc/sample_qc_summary.tsv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  mutate(
    rrna_mean_pct =
      (rrna_r1_pct + rrna_r2_pct) / 2,
    hbrna_mean_pct =
      (hbrna_r1_pct + hbrna_r2_pct) / 2
  )
```

## Sample QC Table
```{r sample-qc-table}
sample_qc <- qc |>
  transmute(
    run,
    sample,
    individual,
    disease_state,
    timepoint,
    mapping_rate =
      round(mapping_rate, 2),
    library_type,
    library_compatible_pct =
      round(library_compatible_pct, 2),
    decoy_pct =
      round(decoy_pct, 2),
    fragment_length_mean =
      round(fragment_length_mean, 2),
    fragment_length_sd =
      round(fragment_length_sd, 2),
    rrna_mean_pct =
      round(rrna_mean_pct, 2),
    hbrna_mean_pct =
      round(hbrna_mean_pct, 2)
  )
reactable(
  sample_qc,
  searchable = TRUE,
  sortable = TRUE,
  resizable = TRUE,
  filterable = TRUE,
  showPageSizeOptions = TRUE,
  defaultPageSize = 10,
  striped = TRUE,
  highlight = TRUE,
  columns = list(
    mapping_rate = colDef(
      name = "Mapping (%)"
    ),
    library_compatible_pct = colDef(
      name = "Compatible (%)"
    ),
    decoy_pct = colDef(
      name = "Decoy (%)"
    ),
    fragment_length_mean = colDef(
      name = "Fragment mean"
    ),
    fragment_length_sd = colDef(
      name = "Fragment SD"
    ),
    rrna_mean_pct = colDef(
      name = "rRNA (%)"
    ),
    hbrna_mean_pct = colDef(
      name = "HbRNA (%)"
    )
  )
)
```

# Salmon QC {.tabset}
## Mapping Rate
```{r mapping-rate}
p <- qc |>
  arrange(mapping_rate) |>
  mutate(
    sample_order = row_number(),
    hover = paste0(
      "Run: ", run,
      "<br>Individual: ", individual,
      "<br>Timepoint: ", timepoint,
      "<br>Mapping: ",
      round(mapping_rate, 2),
      "%"
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(
    aes(
      sample_order,
      mapping_rate,
      text = hover
    )
  ) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    x = "Samples ordered by mapping rate",
    y = "Salmon mapping rate (%)"
  )
ggplotly(
  p,
  tooltip = "text"
)
```

# QC Summary
```{r qc-summary}
qc_summary <- qc |>
  summarise(
    across(
      c(
        mapping_rate,
        library_compatible_pct,
        decoy_pct,
        fragment_length_mean,
        fragment_length_sd,
        rrna_mean_pct,
        hbrna_mean_pct
      ),
      list(
        min = ~ min(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        median = ~ median(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        max = ~ max(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
      )
    )
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = c("metric", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "(.+)_(min|median|max)$"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    across(
      c(min, median, max),
      ~ round(.x, 2)
    ),
    metric = metric |>
      str_replace_all("_", " ") |>
      str_to_sentence()
  ) |>
  rename(
    Metric = metric,
    Minimum = min,
    Median = median,
    Maximum = max
  )
reactable(
  qc_summary,
  pagination = FALSE,
  bordered = TRUE,
  striped = TRUE,
  highlight = TRUE
)
```

## Import Salmon Counts
```{r import-expression}
sample_info <- read_tsv(
  "../config/samples.tsv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
quant_files <- file.path(
  "../data/quant",
  sample_info$run,
  "quant.sf"
)
names(quant_files) <- sample_info$run
if (!all(file.exists(quant_files))) {
  stop("Some Salmon quant.sf files are missing.")
}
gtf <- rtracklayer::import(
  "../data/reference/Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.116.gtf.gz"
)
tx2gene <- as.data.frame(gtf) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(transcript_id),
    !is.na(gene_id)
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(
    transcript_id,
    gene_id
  ) |>
  distinct()
txi <- tximport(
  quant_files,
  type = "salmon",
  tx2gene = tx2gene,
  ignoreTxVersion = TRUE,
  dropInfReps = TRUE
)
gene_counts <- txi$counts
stopifnot(
  ncol(gene_counts) == nrow(sample_info),
  identical(
    colnames(gene_counts),
    sample_info$run
  )
)
tibble(
  Metric = c(
    "Salmon quant files",
    "Imported samples",
    "Genes"
  ),
  Value = c(
    length(quant_files),
    ncol(gene_counts),
    nrow(gene_counts)
  )
) |>
  reactable(
    pagination = FALSE,
    bordered = TRUE
  )
```

## Variance-stabilised Expression
```{r vst-expression}
coldata <- as.data.frame(sample_info)
rownames(coldata) <- coldata$run
stopifnot(
  identical(
    rownames(coldata),
    colnames(txi$counts)
  )
)
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromTximport(
  txi = txi,
  colData = coldata,
  design = ~ 1
)
keep <- rowSums(
  counts(dds) >= 10
) >= 5
dds <- dds[keep, ]
vsd <- vst(
  dds,
  blind = TRUE
)
vst_matrix <- assay(vsd)
tibble(
  Metric = c(
    "Genes before filtering",
    "Genes retained for PCA",
    "Samples"
  ),
  Value = c(
    nrow(gene_counts),
    nrow(vst_matrix),
    ncol(vst_matrix)
  )
) |>
  reactable(
    pagination = FALSE,
    bordered = TRUE
  )
```

## PCA
```{r run-pca}
pca <- prcomp(
  t(vst_matrix),
  center = TRUE,
  scale. = FALSE
)
variance_explained <-
  (pca$sdev^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2)) * 100
pca_data <- as.data.frame(
  pca$x[, 1:4, drop = FALSE]
) |>
  rownames_to_column("run") |>
  left_join(
    sample_info,
    by = "run"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    hover = paste0(
      "Run: ", run,
      "<br>Sample: ", sample,
      "<br>Individual: ", individual,
      "<br>Group: ", disease_state,
      "<br>Timepoint: ", timepoint
    )
  )
```

### PCA Diagnostics {.tabset}
#### Variance Explained
```{r pca-variance}
pca_variance <- tibble(
  PC = paste0(
    "PC",
    seq_len(min(10, length(variance_explained)))
  ),
  Variance = variance_explained[
    seq_len(min(10, length(variance_explained)))
  ]
)
plot_ly(
  data = pca_variance,
  x = ~PC,
  y = ~Variance,
  type = "bar",
  text = ~paste0(
    PC,
    ": ",
    round(Variance, 2),
    "%"
  ),
  hoverinfo = "text"
) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Principal component"
    ),
    yaxis = list(
      title = "Variance explained (%)"
    )
  )
```

# Robust Outlier Detection
```{r robust-outliers}
potential_cutoff <-
  qnorm(0.995)
unambiguous_cutoff <-
  qnorm(0.9995)
robust_scores <- pca_data |>
  dplyr::select(
    run,
    PC1,
    PC2,
    PC3,
    PC4
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = PC1:PC4,
    names_to = "PC",
    values_to = "score"
  ) |>
  group_by(PC) |>
  mutate(
    pc_median =
      median(
        score,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    pc_mad =
      mad(
        score,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    robust_z =
      if_else(
        pc_mad > 0,
        (score - pc_median) / pc_mad,
        NA_real_
      ),
    abs_robust_z =
      abs(robust_z),
    outlier_status = case_when(
      abs_robust_z >= unambiguous_cutoff ~
        "Unambiguous",
      abs_robust_z >= potential_cutoff ~
        "Potential",
      TRUE ~
        "No"
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  left_join(
    sample_info,
    by = "run"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    hover = paste0(
      "Run: ", run,
      "<br>Individual: ", individual,
      "<br>", PC,
      ": ", round(score, 2),
      "<br>Robust Z: ",
      round(robust_z, 2),
      "<br>Status: ",
      outlier_status
    )
  )
```

## Robust Z-score Distribution
```{r robust-z-plot}
plot_ly(
  data = robust_scores,
  x = ~PC,
  y = ~abs_robust_z,
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "markers",
  text = ~hover,
  hoverinfo = "text"
) |>
  layout(
    hovermode = "closest",
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Principal component"
    ),
    yaxis = list(
      title = "Absolute robust Z-score"
    ),
    shapes = list(
      list(
        type = "line",
        xref = "paper",
        x0 = 0,
        x1 = 1,
        y0 = potential_cutoff,
        y1 = potential_cutoff,
        line = list(
          dash = "dash"
        )
      ),
      list(
        type = "line",
        xref = "paper",
        x0 = 0,
        x1 = 1,
        y0 = unambiguous_cutoff,
        y1 = unambiguous_cutoff,
        line = list(
          dash = "dot"
        )
      )
    )
  )
```

## Outlier Summary
```{r outlier-summary}
sample_outliers <- robust_scores |>
  group_by(run) |>
  summarise(
    max_abs_robust_z =
      max(
        abs_robust_z,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    flagged_pc = paste(
      PC[outlier_status != "No"],
      collapse = ", "
    ),
    sample_outlier_status = case_when(
      any(
        outlier_status == "Unambiguous"
      ) ~ "Unambiguous",
      any(
        outlier_status == "Potential"
      ) ~ "Potential",
      TRUE ~ "No"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  rename(
    outlier_status = sample_outlier_status
  ) |>
  left_join(
    sample_info,
    by = "run"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    qc |>
      dplyr::select(
        run,
        mapping_rate,
        library_compatible_pct,
        decoy_pct,
        fragment_length_mean,
        rrna_mean_pct,
        hbrna_mean_pct
      ),
    by = "run"
  )
outlier_counts <- sample_outliers |>
  dplyr::count(
    outlier_status,
    name = "Samples"
  )
reactable(
  outlier_counts,
  pagination = FALSE,
  bordered = TRUE,
  striped = TRUE,
  highlight = TRUE
)
```
